verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh šî·rū Yah·weh šîr ḥā·ḏāš tə·hil·lā·ṯōw biq·hal ḥă·sî·ḏîm
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Sing to the LORD a new song His praise in the assembly of the godly
verses.literalPt: Louvai a Jeová! Cantai a Jeová um novo cântico e o seu louvor, na assembleia dos santos.

verses.original: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־ צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yiś·maḥ yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ō·śāw bə·nê- ṣî·yō·wn yā·ḡî·lū ḇə·mal·kām
verses.literal: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker let the children of Zion rejoice in their King
verses.literalPt: Regozije-se Israel naquele que o fez; exultem os filhos de Sião no seu rei.

verses.original: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lū šə·mōw ḇə·mā·ḥō·wl bə·ṯōp̄ wə·ḵin·nō·wr yə·zam·mə·rū- lōw
verses.literal: Let them praise His name with dancing and make music to Him with tambourine and harp
verses.literalPt: Louvem-lhe o nome com danças; cantem-lhe louvores com adufe e harpa.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- rō·w·ṣeh Yah·weh bə·‘am·mōw yə·p̄ā·’êr ‘ă·nā·wîm bî·šū·‘āh
verses.literal: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people He adorns the afflicted with salvation
verses.literalPt: Porque Jeová se agrada do seu povo; adorna de salvação os humildes.

verses.original: יַעְלְז֣וּ חֲסִידִ֣ים בְּכָב֑וֹד יְ֝רַנְּנ֗וּ עַל־ מִשְׁכְּבוֹתָֽם׃
verses.literal: Let the saints exult in glory let them shout for joy upon their beds
verses.literalPt: Exultem de glória os santos; nos seus leitos, cantem de júbilo.

verses.original: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃
verses.literal: May the high praises of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands
verses.literalPt: Na sua boca, estejam os altos louvores de Deus, e, na sua mão, espada de dois gumes,

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת נְ֭קָמָה בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם תּֽ֝וֹכֵחֹ֗ת בַּל־ אֻמִּֽים׃
verses.literal: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples
verses.literalPt: para exercer vingança sobre as nações e castigos sobre os povos;

verses.original: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃
verses.transliteration: le’·sōr mal·ḵê·hem bə·ziq·qîm wə·niḵ·bə·ḏê·hem bə·ḵaḇ·lê ḇar·zel
verses.literal: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron
verses.literalPt: para lhes meter os reis em cadeias e os nobres em grilhões de ferro;

verses.original: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀ מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־ חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bā·hem miš·pāṭ kā·ṯūḇ hā·ḏār hū lə·ḵāl ḥă·sî·ḏāw hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: to execute the judgment written against them This honor is for all His saints Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: para neles executar o juízo escrito o que será de honra para todos os seus santos. Louvai a Jeová!
